Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was seen carrying the mortal remains of his mother, Savitri Devi, at their ancestral home in Panchur village, Uttarakhand. Savitri Devi passed away at the age of 91 on Friday. Her last rites are scheduled to take place in Uttarakhand, with political leaders and dignitaries expressing condolences to the Chief Minister and his family.
